description: Test suite for frontmatter utilities and parsing functions in shared/frontmatter module, written in TypeScript using vitest testing framework.

methods.name: normalizeStringList
methods.description: Normalizes input into an array of strings, handling comma-separated strings, arrays, and null

methods.name: getFrontmatterString
methods.description: Extracts string value from frontmatter object for a given key, returns undefined if not a string

methods.name: parseFrontmatterBool
methods.description: Parses a string into a boolean value, with a fallback default

methods.name: resolveOpenClawManifestBlock
methods.description: Reads and parses custom metadata fields related to openclaw from frontmatter

methods.name: resolveOpenClawManifestRequires
methods.description: Normalizes requirement lists like binaries, environment variables, and config

methods.name: resolveOpenClawManifestOs
methods.description: Parses and filters OS list array

methods.name: parseOpenClawManifestInstallBase
methods.description: Parses install metadata such as type, id, label, and bins into a structured object

methods.name: applyOpenClawManifestInstallCommonFields
methods.description: Applies common fields to an install object, merging overrides

methods.name: resolveOpenClawManifestInstall
methods.description: Resolves an array of install entries into validated install objects
